title: Turkish Holiday Tagine
description: A festive, oven-baked dish inspired by Turkish cuisine, perfect for special occasions. The gooey cheese and aromatic spices make it a standout.
instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together the feta cheese, honey, cinnamon, and cardamom until well combined.
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with butter.
Spread the feta mixture evenly over the phyllo dough.
Top with sliced almonds and a drizzle of rose water.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the cheese is gooey.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
